say:1:1033511001:1.text: You said before... Eomir was trying to snatch the Lucent Tree's life force for his own immortality?
say:1:1033511001:1.source_cn: 你们之前说，伊米尔是为了自己能够永生，才想夺取弥萨忒赐...
say:1:1033511001:1.male: You said before... Eomir was trying to snatch the Lucent Tree's life force for his own immortality?
say:1:1033511001:1.female: You said before... Eomir was trying to snatch the Lucent Tree's life force for his own immortality?

say:2:1033511002:1.text: It's hard to wrap my head around all this, but the Lucent Tree is really weeping. We used to gaze up at it like it was the night sky! Now look at it!
say:2:1033511002:1.source_cn: 我，难以想象你们说的一切，但流荧树确实在哭泣……曾经我...
say:2:1033511002:1.male: It's hard to wrap my head around all this, but the Lucent Tree is really weeping. We used to gaze up at it like it was the night sky! Now look at it!
say:2:1033511002:1.female: It's hard to wrap my head around all this, but the Lucent Tree is really weeping. We used to gaze up at it like it was the night sky! Now look at it!

say:3:1033511003:1.text: I trust what I'm seeing. Whoever did this to the Dark Forest is in the wrong!
say:3:1033511003:1.source_cn: 我信任眼前的事实……不论是谁，对薄暮丛林犯下这种罪行，...
say:3:1033511003:1.male: I trust what I'm seeing. Whoever did this to the Dark Forest is in the wrong!
say:3:1033511003:1.female: I trust what I'm seeing. Whoever did this to the Dark Forest is in the wrong!
